name: Otto von Guericke University Magdeburg
description: Otto von Guericke University Magdeburg is a public university in Magdeburg, Saxony-Anhalt, founded in 1993. It has about 13,000 students and is strongest in engineering, computer science, medicine and economics.
whyIncluded: Otto von Guericke University Magdeburg is among the 10 universities in Germany most chosen by international students (about 5,400 international students, 41% of 13,121, per a 2026 aggregator figure), per the FinexisEdu shortlist research of October 2026.

livingCosts.summary: The university's own estimate of rent, food and personal costs in Magdeburg for 12 months a year. Transport is covered by the semester fee. Excludes health insurance.
livingCosts.notes: OVGU 'Finance' page for international students: accommodation EUR 300-500 -> midpoint 400; food and beverages 150-350 -> 250; public transportation free for enrolled students (ticket in the semester fee) -> 0; personal = phone/internet 30 + broadcasting fee 18.36 + miscellaneous 'up to 300' (upper bound used) = 348.36, rounded to 348. Health insurance (from 140) excluded. OVGU's own total: approx. EUR 992-1,200 a month (11,904-14,400 a year).

programmes.name: Informatik (Computer Science) B.Sc.
programmes.summary: No tuition, including for international students. The figure is only the compulsory semester fee, which includes a Germany-wide transport ticket.
programmes.notes: No tuition fees: OVGU's 'Finance' page for international students states 'There are no tuition fees'. Compulsory fees = semester fee EUR 329.30 per semester x2 = 658.60 (stated on the same page, not itemised there). OVGU's 'Semester Fee' page (ovgu.de/en/-p-48762.html) still shows the earlier EUR 311.30 = Studentenwerk 90.00 + Deutschlandsemesterticket 208.80 + student body 12.50 without naming the semester; 329.30 matches the same items with the ticket at its 2026/27 price of 226.80. No 2024/2025 history: no page found that dates an earlier semester fee. Standard period 7 semesters (OVGU bachelor's overview, ovgu.de/unimagdeburg/en/bachelor-p-48818.html). OVGU also offers a Bilingual Computer Science B.Sc. Language not read from the programme page; OVGU's bachelor's degrees are mostly German-taught.
